blocks.prompt: 3 (i) Find the equation of the parabola having its focus at the origin and directrix is parallel to: \(x\)-axis
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein directrix ka number nahi diya, sirf itna kaha hai ke woh \(x\)-axis ke parallel hai. To hum us ka naam rakh lete hain.
\(x\)-axis ke parallel har line \(y = d\) jaisi hoti hai (horizontal line).
Yahan \(d\) (\(d \ne 0\)) origin se directrix tak ka directed distance (sign wala faasla) hai: upar ho to positive, neeche ho to negative.
Focus origin par hai, to definition \(|PO| = |PM|\) lagayenge.
Jawab mein \(d\) baqi rahega; yeh theek hai, kyun ke directrix ki jagah maloom hi nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya: focus \(O(0, 0)\); directrix \(x\)-axis ke parallel, maan lein \(y = d\) (\(d \ne 0\)).
Maloom karna: parabola ki equation.
Tareeqa: point \(P(x, y)\) ke liye \(|PO| = |PM|\).

Dono faasle
\[|PO|^{2} = x^{2} + y^{2}\]
\[|PM| = |y - d|\]
Kyun: \(y = d\) horizontal line hai, is liye us tak faasla sirf seedha upar neeche ka farq \(|y - d|\) hai. Origin se faasla distance formula se \(\sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}}\).

Barabar rakh kar simplify
\[x^{2} + y^{2} = (y - d)^{2}\]
\[x^{2} + y^{2} = y^{2} - 2dy + d^{2}\]
\[x^{2} = -2dy + d^{2}\]
Kyun: dono taraf square kiya; \(y^{2}\) dono taraf se cancel ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: \((y - d)^{2}\) mein beech wala term \(-2dy\) mat bhooliye.

Tasdeeq:
\(d = -2\) lein: \(x^{2} = 4y + 4 = 4(y + 1)\). Vertex \((0, -1)\), \(a = 1\), focus \((0, -1 + 1) = (0, 0)\), directrix \(y = -2\). Bilkul sahi. Answer key bhi \(x^{2} = -2dy + d^{2}\) deti hai.
Dekhiye: \(d < 0\) (directrix neeche) ho to parabola upar khulta hai, aur \(d > 0\) ho to neeche.
blocks.final_answer: \(x^{2} = -2dy + d^{2}\), jahan directrix \(y = d\) hai (\(d\) = origin se directrix tak directed distance).

blocks.prompt: 3 (ii) Find the equation of the parabola having its focus at the origin and directrix is parallel to: \(y\)-axis
blocks.explanation:
Bilkul pehle hisse jaisa sawal hai, bas directrix ab \(y\)-axis ke parallel hai.
\(y\)-axis ke parallel line vertical hoti hai: \(x = d\) (\(d \ne 0\)).
Is tak faasla \(|x - d|\) hai.
Phir wohi \(|PO| = |PM|\), square, aur cancel.
Agar pehla hissa samajh aa gaya to yeh do minute ka kaam hai; yahi maths ki khoobsurti hai ke ek tareeqa kai sawal khol deta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: focus \(O(0, 0)\); directrix \(x = d\) (\(d \ne 0\)).
Maloom karna: parabola ki equation.
Tareeqa: \(P(x, y)\) ke liye \(|PO| = |PM|\).

Faasle barabar rakh kar square
\[x^{2} + y^{2} = (x - d)^{2}\]
\[x^{2} + y^{2} = x^{2} - 2dx + d^{2}\]
\[y^{2} = -2dx + d^{2}\]
Kyun: vertical line \(x = d\) tak faasla \(|x - d|\) hai; square ke baad \(x^{2}\) dono taraf se cancel ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: yeh pehle hisse ka jawab hi hai, bas \(x\) aur \(y\) ne jagah badal li hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(d = 2\) lein: \(y^{2} = -4x + 4 = -4(x - 1)\). Vertex \((1, 0)\), \(a = 1\), baayen khulta hai, focus \((1 - 1, 0) = (0, 0)\), directrix \(x = 2\). Sahi! Answer key bhi yahi deti hai.
